rules.text: A credit note or corrective document must contain a specific, unambiguous reference to the initial invoice and the details being amended.
VAT on an exempt intra-EU supply of goods becomes chargeable on the invoice date or the 15th day of the month following the supply, whichever is earlier (Article 67 VAT Directive).
Buyer VAT numbers for intra-EU B2B supplies are validated against the Commission VIES service before the invoice is issued. VIES outages are retried, not treated as invalid.
rules.notes: Engine behavior verified by a live VIES call during development; the page itself is not text-monitored.

rules.text: EU VAT rules prescribe no invoice language. Member States may require a translation of invoices for supplies in their territory, but may not require all invoices to be translated (VAT Directive art. 248a).
rules.notes: Article 248a is cited by papierkram.de and verkanto.eu (secondary). The EUR-Lex fetch was truncated before art. 248a, so the article text itself was not read.
